question: ____________ wins the Best Male Playback Singer at the 67th National Film Awards.
solution:
The correct answer is __**B Praak**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **B Praak** wins the Best Male Playback Singer at the 67th National Film Awards.
 
• The National Film Awards are one of the most prominent film award ceremonies in India, established in 1954.
 
• They are administered by the Directorate of Film Festivals, an organization set up by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, India.
 
• B Praak won the award for his soulful rendition of the song "Teri Mitti" from the film **Kesari**.
 
• His powerful voice and emotional delivery in "Teri Mitti" received wide acclaim and resonated with audiences across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **National Film Awards** are divided into three sections: Feature Films, Non-Feature Films, and Best Writing on Cinema.
 
• Winners of the National Film Awards are decided by a national panel of judges appointed by the Indian government.
 
• The awards aim to encourage the production of films of high aesthetic and technical standards and educational and culture value.
 
• Each year, the awards ceremony is held in New Delhi, where the President of India presents the awards.
 
• In addition to the Best Male Playback Singer, awards are given in various categories including Best Feature Film, Best Actor, Best Actress, and Best Director.
